visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens on a bustling Harajuku street in front of the @cosme TOKYO storefront. A young woman with pink-tinted hair and a white padded jacket waves at the camera while smiling. Two staff members in grey uniforms stand near the entrance under a large lit sign. (2) Inside the store, the camera pans across the 'mini cosmetics' section. The environment is brightly lit with a clean, white architectural style. Small bottles of skincare and makeup are neatly arranged on minimalist shelving. The creator holds up small travel-sized samples to the camera. (3) The scene shifts to the sales ranking area, featuring glowing circular shelves. Each shelf displays products labeled with '1位', '2位', and '3位' ranking signs. The camera glides past various categories like lotions and emulsions. (4) In the 'Tester Bar' area, there are sleek white islands with circular mirrors and integrated sinks. The creator is seen reflected in a mirror, applying product to her face and gesturing toward the camera. (5) A massive 'Mask Wall' is shown, filled with a grid of colorful face mask packaging. The creator points to specific brands. Close-up shots highlight 'Lululun' brand masks. (6) The creator is shown in a different setting with a towel around her shoulders, applying a sheet mask to her face. She touches her cheek to demonstrate the texture. (7) Back in the store, the 'POP UP' area features large digital screens showing SK-II advertisements and red-carpeted floors. (8) A brief shot of a nursing room follows, showing a mirror and a man attending to a baby in a stroller. (9) On the third floor, rows of high-end perfume bottles are displayed in glass cases. A man in a black turtleneck is seen smelling fragrance samples. (10) The final scene shows the creator and a friend in a blue beanie holding large '@cosme' branded shopping bags, smiling and posing in front of a mirror.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 female main creator, 1 female friend at the end, 1 male in the nursing room, 1 baby, 1 male in the perfume section, 2 female staff members at the entrance, several distant customers.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with short, pink-tinted blonde hair. She wears a white oversized padded jacket over a grey knit sweater and a long grey tulle skirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The primary setting is the interior of a flagship cosmetics store characterized by white minimalist futuristic architecture, bright circular lighting fixtures, and organized product displays. Some scenes show a modern street in Harajuku and a private bathroom-like setting for mask application.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, mid-tempo electronic pop BGM featuring a steady synth bass and electronic drum beat. A male narrator delivers clear, enthusiastic Mandarin speech, introducing the Tokyo shopping location. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX signals a transition as the narrator begins detailing the mini cosmetics section. The BGM remains constant, providing a rhythmic backdrop. (3) As the narrator mentions the ranking list, a subtle digital 'ding' sound effect is heard, coinciding with the visual ranking highlights. The speech is rhythmic and well-paced. (4) During the description of the tester bar and face washing, the narrator's tone remains friendly and encouraging. The BGM filters slightly but maintains its upbeat energy. (5) A 'pop' bubble SFX occurs as the mask wall is mentioned. The narrator highlights specific brand names like 'Lululun' with emphasized pitch contour. (6) The final phase features a crescendo in the BGM as the narrator invites viewers to visit the store, ending with a clean fade-out of the music following the last word.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Feature 1 (Mini) -> Feature 2 (Ranking) -> Feature 3 (Testing) -> Feature 4 (Masks) -> Feature 5 (Services) -> Outro/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comprehensive travel and shopping guide for the newly renovated @cosme TOKYO flagship store in Harajuku. By showcasing specific floor highlights such as the ranking charts, mini-sized samples, and private testing areas, it aims to attract female tourists and beauty enthusiasts to visit the physical store.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video provides deep-dive features into specific brands like Lululun and SK-II, including sales stats and product efficacy descriptions.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high density of visual overlays and rapid editing typical of social media commerce (TikTok/Instagram style) to maintain high arousal and deliver information quickly.
